name: Healthy food and vegetables online store: launch plan and first-year costs
about: Launching an online store with healthy food, fresh vegetables and fruit, built on PrestaShop (self-hosted, open source), with local same-day or next-day delivery in insulated boxes, a small rented warehouse with commercial refrigerators and a cold room, and packaging supplies. Assumes a mid-size US city and US food rules; prices in US dollars. Four phases: Analysis, Implementation, a 3-month launch period with a bigger launch promotion and higher costs, and operation for months 4-12. Staff: two warehouse and delivery workers, about $6,200 a month together with payroll taxes. days = the owner's or team's project work in man-days (the editor turns it into labor cost as days x rate); capex = fixed assets bought (equipment, furniture, hardware); opex = operating outlays (rent, wages, stock, platform fees, marketing). Costs only: no revenue, and no ongoing stock reorders, payment fees or shipping costs, since they depend on sales.
